data.narrative:
Tekever is a Series C-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $631M to date. The comparable universe in Drones & Autonomous comprises six private companies including Zipline, Joby Aviation, Nuro, Archer Aviation, and Elroy Air, with no direct public market comps available.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable triangulation method given data constraints. Using $631M in total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C progression yields an implied valuation of $1.1B. A peer-median approach was not viable; while five same-sector peers exist, none qualified as narrow comparables under stage, adjacent-stage, or valuation-tier filters, with only one adjacent-stage peer identified. Relying on all-sector median data would introduce excessive noise.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $912M to $1.2B, with $1.1B as the central estimate. This range reflects the single applicable method and material uncertainty around comparable company selection and appropriate stage-progression multiples for frontier autonomous systems businesses. Key risks to valuation include customer concentration, regulatory pathway clarity, and the absence of recent comparable transactions in this subsector.
